sources.note: Main vendor site. Describes TriMed Complete as cloud-based EHR + PM platform. Founded 1996, 28+ years experience. AWS-hosted. Key modules: EHR, PM, patient portal, telemedicine, mobile, digital check-in. Emphasis on pediatric focus. Pricing: $589/mo per MD, $389/mo per mid-level.

EHR feature page. Lists interactive notation, e-Rx management, vaccine management, clinical reporting, decision support, ubiquitous access, mobile, scheduling, claims management, eligibility verification, document management.
Practice management feature page. Describes scheduling, claims management, eligibility, document management, reporting, advanced collections, authorization tracking, patient recall.
Pediatric EHR page. Highlights vaccine management, growth tracking, well-child visit workflows, family communication via portal. Describes product as pediatric-specific by design.

AI tools/telemedicine page. Describes Amazon HealthScribe ambient AI for clinical documentation, AI-powered OCR for scanned documents, ICD-10 code predictions, medication recommendations, AI-driven smart scheduling.

Patient demographics page. Describes management of name, address, phone, DOB, guarantor info, primary/secondary contacts, insurance details. Patients can self-update via portal with practice verification.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms 49 certification criteria. Describes CCDA/XML export, Surescripts integration, 34 CQM metrics. Pricing: standard license + monthly support, additional fees for Direct messaging, EPCS, lab connectivity, data hosting.

2012 press release about e-Medsys 7.1. Key history: TriMed founded 1996, began implementing e-Medsys 2004, acquired e-Medsys source code and trademark July 2010. Product suite includes PM, charting, patient portal, mobile EHR, document manager, EDI manager. Integrations with Apple, Oracle, ZirMed.

FindEMR product profile. Describes cloud-based PM, scheduling, patient portal, digital check-in, medical billing with consolidated family balance, e-prescriptions, telemedicine. Notes vendor has not disclosed third-party integrations. Target: small to large clinics.

EMRSystems review. Describes clinical references, interactive notation, e-prescribing, medication management, patient history snapshots, specialty-specific templates, imaging/diagnostic integration, collections, scheduling, authorization tracking, EDI management, patient portal, and 'Amplify' mobile web-based module.

Capterra reviews page (403 - could not access directly). Search results indicate generally positive reviews praising customer support, ease of use, and efficient charting. Billing module noted as cumbersome by some users.
Software Advice profile (403 - could not access directly). Listed as source for pricing and feature overview from search results.
LeadIQ company profile. Reports 51-200 employees as of April 2025, approximately 51 employees across 3 continents (North America, Asia, Europe).
Tracxn company profile. Reports 11-50 employees as of Jul 2024, est. $1.7M annual revenue.
